cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(nupp_c_library_probe C)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
# A reused probe directory must resolve the current exact prefixes again.
foreach(found ZLIB_INCLUDE OPENSSL_INCLUDE CURL_INCLUDE ZLIB_LIBRARY CRYPTO_LIBRARY SSL_LIBRARY CURL_LIBRARY)
  unset(${found} CACHE)
endforeach()
find_path(ZLIB_INCLUDE zlib.h PATHS "${NUPP_ZLIB}/include" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_path(OPENSSL_INCLUDE openssl/evp.h PATHS "${NUPP_OPENSSL}/include" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_path(CURL_INCLUDE curl/curl.h PATHS "${NUPP_CURL}/include" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(ZLIB_LIBRARY NAMES z libz zlib zlib1 PATHS "${NUPP_ZLIB}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(CRYPTO_LIBRARY NAMES crypto libcrypto PATHS "${NUPP_OPENSSL}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(SSL_LIBRARY NAMES ssl libssl PATHS "${NUPP_OPENSSL}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
find_library(CURL_LIBRARY NAMES curl libcurl libcurl_imp PATHS "${NUPP_CURL}/lib" NO_DEFAULT_PATH REQUIRED)
add_executable(c-library-probe probe.c)
target_compile_definitions(c-library-probe PRIVATE NUPP_EXPECT_TARGET="${NUPP_TARGET}")
target_include_directories(c-library-probe PRIVATE "${ZLIB_INCLUDE}" "${OPENSSL_INCLUDE}" "${CURL_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(c-library-probe PRIVATE "${CURL_LIBRARY}" "${SSL_LIBRARY}" "${CRYPTO_LIBRARY}" "${ZLIB_LIBRARY}")
# Assertions are the probe, including in release builds.
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(c-library-probe PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
else()
  target_compile_options(c-library-probe PRIVATE -UNDEBUG -Wall -Wextra -Werror)
endif()
set_property(TARGET c-library-probe PROPERTY BUILD_RPATH "${NUPP_CURL}/lib;${NUPP_OPENSSL}/lib;${NUPP_ZLIB}/lib")
